description: This class implements a form renderer for the OFBiz widget framework using Freemarker macros. It provides methods to generate the markup for various form fields, including labels, input elements, buttons, and form wrappers, by invoking Freemarker macros and managing context data. The class is highly involved in rendering complex, styled, and dynamic HTML forms based on the model form definitions.

classes.name: MacroFormRenderer
classes.description: An implementation of FormStringRenderer that uses Freemarker macros to render complex form structures within the OFBiz framework. It manages macro invocation, context data, and generates HTML form components for a dynamic, styled user interface.
